resources.string: Choose your boundaries—cuisine deal-breakers, budget, distance, and rating floor—then let BlindDate handle the decision. We pick a single restaurant that fits your rules. The twist? You won’t see the name until you pull up. Navigation is built-in, and if a pick doesn’t feel right, you can skip and reroll. Spontaneous, but smart.
Mystery dinner, dialed to your taste.
We guide you to a surprise spot nearby
We use your location to find great places close to you and show a stealth route (no spoilers).
Granting location helps us pick nearby spots and navigate you there. You can change this anytime in Settings.
Location is required for BlindDate to work.
